classification_policy.primary_topic_id: One active primary topic per vocabulary sense; topic_ids starts with primary and contains meaningful secondary topics only.
classification_policy.primary_subtopic_id: Optional. If nonnull, must appear in subtopic_ids and belong to the primary topic.
classification_policy.subtopic_ids: Optional subtopics must be children of at least one listed topic; categories without defined subtopics use an empty array.
classification_policy.versioning: Top-level IDs for the previous 20 categories are stable. The v2 registry is a JSON object rather than the legacy unversioned array.
